header.title: Needs you
header.description: What your agents need from you — questions, to-dos, approvals, missing logins, 2FA codes — plus updates from their work.

open.title: All clear — your agents have everything they need
open.description: When an agent needs a decision, your OK, a login it doesn't have or a 2FA code, it lands here instead of getting lost in a chat.

resolved.title: Nothing resolved yet
resolved.description: Requests you fix — by adding a login or 2FA code, or marking them resolved — are kept here for reference.

dismissed.title: Nothing dismissed
dismissed.description: Requests you dismiss are parked here. Reopen them any time.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.clearDescription_one: This removes {{count}} notification. Agent runs and their results are not affected.
notifications.clearDescription_other: This removes {{count}} notifications. Agent runs and their results are not affected.
notifications.emptyDescription: Agents post updates here when they finish work, need something, or hit a problem.

question.stopTitle: Stop the run — the question is withdrawn

linkTotp.readyDescription: Agents type this code in on their next sign-in.
linkTotp.title: Use a saved 2FA code
linkTotp.description: Pick the code for {{host}}. Godmode links it to the right login, so agents fill it in by themselves next time.
linkTotp.noLogin: No login is saved for {{host}} yet. Add the login first, then link its 2FA here.
linkTotp.searchPlaceholder: Search 2FA codes by service, account or login…
linkTotp.noCodes: Your vault has no 2FA codes yet.
linkTotp.hiddenMore_one: {{count}} more. Keep typing to narrow it down.
linkTotp.hiddenMore_other: {{count}} more. Keep typing to narrow it down.
linkTotp.importNew: Not there? Import a new code

outcome.alreadyLinked: Already linked to {{who}}. This closes the request.
outcome.staysCovered: It stays with {{owner}}, which already covers {{host}}.
outcome.sameAccount: Same account: it stays with {{owner}} ({{domain}}) and {{host}} is added to that login, so both sign-ins get the code.

noMatch.title: Nothing matches
noMatch.description: Try another word or clear the filter.
